turns.question: What was the total ad spend on days when the email campaign had no booked lead, from 17 August to 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The email channel had a booking on 21 August, 2 September, 14 September and 26 September 2026, and the semantic layer cannot sum spend over days chosen by another metric's value, so it gives no single total; ad spend (EUR, all campaigns) on the remaining days was EUR 730 for 17-20 August, EUR 2,125 for 22 August-1 September, EUR 2,235 for 3-13 September, EUR 2,355 for 15-25 September and EUR 1,295 for 27 September-2 October 2026 (EUR 9,555 for the whole 17 August-2 October period, booking days included). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
